'''John Petelle''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 45 FL from Lincoln, NE. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

He organized Lincoln tournaments from soon after release. Two local players qualified for the 1997 World Championships.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
